handoff.name: SOAP note
handoff.intro: Write the clinician's consultation note in clipped clinical style, the way a GP records it in the record. Abbreviations are fine (hx, PMH, DH, SH, O/E, imp, plan, /7 for days, /12 for months). No invented examination findings, observations, or investigation results — a remote consultation often has none. Do not restate the whole conversation; record only what is clinically relevant.

sections.label: History
sections.guidance: presenting complaint; onset and duration; character; associated symptoms; relevant positives and pertinent negatives (red-flag negatives explicitly)

sections.label: Background
sections.guidance: PMH, current medications and what has already been tried for this problem, allergies, relevant social history and impact on daily life

sections.label: Examination
sections.guidance: any examination findings or observations stated; if the consultation was remote and none were done, write 'not examined (remote consultation)'

sections.label: Impression
sections.guidance: the clinician's working diagnosis or differential as stated

sections.label: Plan
sections.guidance: investigations, prescription, self-care advice, referral, and the follow-up / review interval

sections.label: Safety-netting
sections.guidance: the specific worsening symptoms the patient was told to watch for and what to do; if none were given, write 'none documented'

family.closing_line: Contact the surgery or 111 if you are unsure or things get worse.
family.notes: This is an after-visit summary written TO the patient in the second person. Cover: what you talked about, what the clinician thinks is going on (in plain words), what to do now (medicines, self-care), when you will be seen again, and the specific warning signs that mean you should seek help sooner. Do not invent test results or a firm diagnosis the clinician did not give.
